note: The Hone: measured the game client at seed 42 and found Driver::start taking 27,522 ms and 300-630 ms per movement turn under the default cargo profile, versus 3,756 ms and 10-80 ms under --release. Cause: clients/game, clients/vessel/wasm and clients/world-wasm are each a standalone excluded workspace root, so the root Cargo.tomls Whetstone opt-level=2 dev profile (Cargo.toml:60-80) never reached them and every dev build there ran the whole simulation at opt-level 0. Fix: appended the same three profile blocks to each of the three workspace roots. Guard: a new architecture test, every_client_workspace_declares_an_optimised_dev_profile in cli/tests/suite/architecture.rs, walks clients/ for standalone [workspace] roots and fails red if any lacks an optimised [profile.dev] and [profile.dev.package.star]; verified red by deleting the block from clients/game/Cargo.toml and reverting.
